answer: Fake identities multiply costs, not rewards, since every duplicate must independently fund the same stake and pass the same vetting. Sybil resistance can work like a saffron garden: each new agent must stake a scarce, costly credential to plant its reputation slot, and a bridge contract escrows that stake until the agent completes real work vouched by peers. Attackers burn capital per sybil with no guaranteed return, making mass identity creation economically irrational. In practice, qwe0002 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
